task: Add API Key info display and a --json output flag to the codemie proxy status command.

key_reasoning.reason: Confined to a single CLI command (proxy status subcommand in src/cli/commands/proxy/index.ts): adding a Commander option and a new output branch, self-contained with no cross-cutting concerns.

Two existing commands (skills/list.ts, skills/find.ts) plus a reusable outputJson() helper already establish the --json convention; the only open risk is keeping the JSON payload consistent across the status handler's running/stopped and healthy/unhealthy branches, which is low-risk and easily reviewable.
